intro: Finished Zade and Addie and want more? These are grouped by what you're after: the closest matches, gentler reads, darker ones, MM and sapphic stalker romance, and gothic or fantasy picks. We've mixed the BookTok favourites with ones you probably haven't seen on every list.

sections.heading: Stalker romance books like Haunting Adeline
sections.note: The closest matches: a man who watches from the shadows and will not stop.

recs.title: Pretty Monster
recs.author: Sheridan Anne
recs.reason: Kyah, a Brooklyn tattoo artist, has a man slipping in through her window at night, and she starts to want him to. A cat-and-mouse stalker romance with plenty of bite.

recs.title: I Will Break You
recs.author: Gigi Styx
recs.reason: Amethyst ran Xero's fan club and wrote to him while he was on death row. Then he escaped and came for her. An obsessive, unhinged hero and a story full of mind games.

recs.title: I Will Mend You
recs.author: Gigi Styx
recs.reason: The second half of the Pen Pal duet, straight after I Will Break You. Unreliable narrators, and it gets even more twisted.

recs.title: Stalking Ginevra
recs.author: Gigi Styx
recs.reason: A masked man kills Ginevra's fiancé, and she offers him anything to stay alive. A long, dark stalker romance from Gigi Styx's Morally Black series.

recs.title: Twist Me
recs.author: Anna Zaires
recs.reason: Julian has been fixated on Nora for a long time before he takes her to his private island. If Zade's single-minded obsession is what hooked you, start here.

recs.title: That Sik Luv
recs.author: Jescie Hall
recs.reason: An indie stalker romance readers often put next to Haunting Adeline when asked for an unhinged, obsessive hero.

recs.title: Notice
recs.author: K. Webster
recs.reason: A shorter stalker romance from an author known for going very dark. Good if you want the watching-from-the-shadows feeling without starting a long series.

recs.title: Does It Hurt?
recs.author: H.D. Carlton
recs.reason: The same author, a different set-up: Sawyer has been on the run for years when she meets Enzo. Read it for more of Carlton's voice and her morally grey men.

recs.title: The Pucking Wrong Number
recs.author: C.R. Jane
recs.reason: A wrong-number text puts her in the sights of a hockey player who won't let go. Stalker romance with a sports setting and a funnier tone.

sections.heading: Books like Haunting Adeline but less dark
sections.note: The obsession and the tension, with less of the violence.

recs.title: Lights Out
recs.author: Navessa Allen
recs.reason: A trauma nurse who follows masked-men thirst traps online realises the anonymous man she's been watching is watching her too. All the mask, a lot more laughs, and she's fully into it.

recs.title: Twisted Love
recs.author: Ana Huang
recs.reason: Alex, her brother's cold best friend, has been watching Ava for years. Far less dark than Adeline, but the hero's fixation is just as intense.

recs.title: The Maddest Obsession
recs.author: Danielle Lori
recs.reason: An FBI agent with a dangerous fixation on a mafia princess. Possessive and steamy, with a sharp, funny heroine.

recs.title: Butcher & Blackbird
recs.author: Brynne Weaver
recs.reason: Two serial killers turn their rivalry into something else. Plenty of blood, but the tone is playful rather than harrowing.

sections.heading: Darker than Haunting Adeline
sections.note: Where Zade and Addie were just the warm-up.

recs.title: Hunting Adeline
recs.author: H.D. Carlton
recs.reason: The second half of the story. Zade goes after Addie, and the duet goes somewhere much darker.

recs.title: Captive in the Dark
recs.author: C.J. Roberts
recs.reason: Caleb takes Livvie, and the book doesn't look away. An older captive romance that many readers call the book that started it all for them.

recs.title: Comfort Food
recs.author: Kitty Thomas
recs.reason: A short, notorious captive story about control and conditioning. Much darker than Adeline, and one of the genre's most talked-about extremes.

recs.title: Corrupt
recs.author: Penelope Douglas
recs.reason: Masks, Devil's Night and a revenge plot. Michael is her boyfriend's older brother, and he has been waiting for this.

recs.title: The Ritual
recs.author: Shantel Tessier
recs.reason: The Lords are a secret society you join with your blood. Manipulation and obsession that start as romance and get very twisted.

recs.title: God of Malice
recs.author: Rina Kent
recs.reason: Killian's fixation on Glyndon starts the night they meet and only gets worse. An obsessive hero with a university setting.

recs.title: Always Watching
recs.author: Lee McCormick & RS McKenzie
recs.reason: A serial killer decides a camboy belongs to him and sets out to protect him by any means. Dark MM stalker romance, first in a series.

recs.title: Stalked
recs.author: Ryan Mundy
recs.reason: He was only meant to get information out of him, but he can't stop coming back every night. A standalone MM stalker romance with a mafia edge.

recs.title: Let The Mask Fall
recs.author: G.E. Masters
recs.reason: A sapphic dark romance with a masked stalker, mob ties and a possessive heroine. Readers single out its ending.

recs.title: Burning Heaven
recs.author: Haydn Hubbard
recs.reason: Addie has a stalker, and not the romantic kind. Sapphic mafia romance with a serial killer plot running through it.

sections.heading: Gothic and fantasy books like Haunting Adeline
sections.note: For readers who loved the creepy old house as much as the hero.

recs.title: Gothikana
recs.author: RuNyx
recs.reason: A mist-covered gothic university full of secrets, and a brooding hero drawn to the heroine from the start.

recs.title: Phantasma
recs.author: Kaylie Smith
recs.reason: A deadly game in a haunted setting and a demon love interest. Dark fantasy romance for when you want the spooky atmosphere turned up.
